conduct.intro: Issho is for making friends. To keep outings safe and comfortable for everyone:
conduct.rule.kind: Be kind and respectful to everyone in your group.
conduct.rule.platonic: Issho is for friendship. Romantic feelings sometimes happen, and that's fine, but come to outings with platonic intentions and respect other people's boundaries.
conduct.rule.privacy: Respect people's privacy. Don't share their photos or details without asking.
conduct.rule.reliable: Turn up when you've confirmed, and cancel early if you can't.
conduct.rule.report: Report anyone who makes you or others uncomfortable.
conduct.rule.safe: Meet in the agreed public place, and drink responsibly.
conduct.title: Code of conduct
